tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Terracotta, the one accent. Primary buttons, active dots, the Route tab disc, a saved heart. White text on it is 4.14:1, so keep that text at 15px/800 or larger and never use it for body copy.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state for primary buttons. Also accent-coloured text and links on bg or card (5.05:1 on bg).

tokens.name: accent-glow
tokens.usage: Light terracotta wash behind inline errors and selected date chips. Put accent-hover text on it (4.79:1).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Indigo. All primary text on bg, bg-2 and card (14:1 on bg). Also the fill of a selected filter chip, with white text.

tokens.name: ink-soft
tokens.usage: Secondary dark text: timeline times and detail chips on bg-2 (8.7:1).

tokens.name: ink-deep
tokens.usage: Darkest indigo. The booking-code block on the ticket, and text on gold tags.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: Small labels and tags only (e.g. the 'unified style' overline, fact tags). Always ink or ink-deep text on it (8:1). Never a button or a large area.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Sand. The page background behind every screen.

tokens.name: bg-2
tokens.usage: Sand 2. Underlays: photo placeholders, detail chips, segmented tracks.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: 1px card borders, 1.5px secondary-button and chip borders, dividers. Decorative only (1.31:1 on card), so a control is never told apart by its line alone.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: captions, meta, descriptions, unselected segment labels. 5.4:1 on bg, 5.9:1 on card, 4.85:1 on bg-2.

tokens.name: muted-2
tokens.usage: Inactive nav icons and labels from the approved design. Only 3.11:1 on card, so use it for icons (at least 3:1), not small text.

tokens.name: placeholder
tokens.usage: The mountain glyph in empty photo slots on bg-2. Decorative only (2.29:1).

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, icon buttons, secondary buttons and unselected chips. Also the text colour on accent and ink fills.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Confirmed states: a 'free cancellation' chip or a synced booking. Text on success-bg (5.7:1). Always pair it with a check icon or a word.

tokens.name: success-bg
tokens.usage: The ground under success text.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Primary and secondary button labels. Use 13px at the compact 44px height.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Один акцент, один тёмный, тёплый фон.
styles.usage: Descriptions and paragraphs, usually in muted.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Card meta and swatch notes, in muted.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Uppercase section labels and badges (0.04em on gold tags).

styles.name: tab-label
styles.usage: Tab bar labels. The Route tab uses weight 800.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Badge vertical padding and the gap between a card title and its meta.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap inside chips and between a swatch and its label.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between chips in a row and between buttons on a card.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Gap in swatch rows and icon-button rows. Badge inset from the photo edge.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Gap between header items. Padding of compact cards.

tokens.name: space-14
tokens.usage: Card body padding, the horizontal padding of chips and fields, and the tab bar's side inset.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Screen gutter on content lists.

tokens.name: space-18
tokens.usage: Button horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-22
tokens.usage: Screen gutter on the style and hero screens, and the gap between sections.

tokens.name: space-28
tokens.usage: Top padding of a screen.

tokens.name: radius-thumb
tokens.usage: Thumbnails, date chips, inline notes and the ticket code block.

tokens.name: radius-btn
tokens.usage: Every button and the search field.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Cards, the ticket and the route stats pill.

tokens.name: radius-sheet
tokens.usage: Top corners of bottom sheets.

tokens.name: radius-chip
tokens.usage: Filter chips, badges, segmented controls and the tab bar lens.

tokens.name: h-btn
tokens.usage: Button height. 44px is the compact variant on cards.

tokens.name: h-chip
tokens.usage: Filter chip and segmented item height.

tokens.name: size-icon-btn
tokens.usage: Round icon buttons. 38px when one sits over a card photo.

tokens.name: nav-h
tokens.usage: Tab bar height, and the bottom padding scroll areas reserve for it.

tokens.name: app-max-w
tokens.usage: Max width of the app column. Everything is designed at 390px.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: The only shadow a resting card may have. Most cards use a line border and no shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-cta
tokens.usage: Glow under a primary (accent) button.

tokens.name: shadow-nav
tokens.usage: The floating glass tab bar.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: The ticket and hovered tour cards.

tokens.name: shadow-thumb
tokens.usage: The white thumb of a segmented control.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets rising over the dimmed page.
